recommendations.name: CodeRabbit Merge Risk
recommendations.description: A paid reviewer that rates every PR Minimal, Low, Moderate, High or Critical at the end of each review, on GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps and Bitbucket, available on its Essentials, Team, Advanced and Enterprise plans.

recommendations.name: DRS-OSS
recommendations.description: An open-source, self-hostable GitHub App, web UI and REST API that uses a fine-tuned Llama 3.1 8B model to give each PR a defect-likelihood risk label, with code at https://github.com/Ali-Sayed-Salehi/drs-llm.

recommendations.name: pr-risk-scorer
recommendations.description: A lightweight GitHub Action that scores each PR by structural risk across five dimensions and posts the result as a PR comment, though I could not load its page to verify details.
